scenario: Bupropion with no release form stated; allowlist names only SR and XL
labeledFrom: SPEC section 2 allowlists "bupropion SR" and "bupropion XL" only, so an unspecified bupropion cannot be matched to an allowlisted form. IMPLEMENTATION-SPECIFIC (not derived from SPEC section 4): M01/M02 dose-form and identity checks (docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-003) deliberately over-escalate. Escalation (not a plain renewal) is the conservative reading.
